plainTranslation: With Composite Jupiter in the 6th house, this can be excellent for a work relationship, and you create more work opportunities together. In a personal relationship, you can do well with daily life together, and this is good for a partnership focused on health (like you and a personal trainer or dietician or doctor), but can also be good for a romantic relationship. Jupiter here can help mitigate some of the inequality associated with this house, and while one of you may do more, the other can show appropriate appreciation for it.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
